versions.changelog:
Initial release of work-productivity-gog-google-workflow-helper:

- Introduces a skill to deliver Gog-style workflow support for Google Workspace and related productivity tasks.
- Supports bug fixing, setup hardening, reliability improvements, and creation of adjacent workflows based on validated demand.
- Includes a step-by-step process: clarify requirements, propose plans, request only critical missing info, generate user-friendly outputs (scripts, checklists, templates), and validate results.
- Offers triggers for workflows involving work-productivity, gog, google, workspace, CLI tools, and practical workflow requests.
